reviews.text: The Purito Bamboo Serum is a gentle and soothing product that works well for everyday use. The texture is very light and absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving any sticky or heavy feeling. Despite being lightweight, it provides enough hydration to keep the skin comfortable and balanced throughout the day. It feels calming on the skin, making it suitable even for sensitive skin types. Overall, it’s a simple yet effective serum that hydrates without overwhelming the skin.
reviews.zh: Purito Bamboo Serum 係一款溫和、舒緩嘅產品，日常使用都好好。質地好輕盈，吸收快，搽完唔會有黏膩或者厚重感。雖然質地輕，但提供足夠嘅水分，令皮膚全日都保持舒適同平衡。搽落感覺舒緩，即使敏感皮膚都啱用。總括嚟講，係一款簡單但有效嘅精華，補水但唔會令皮膚負擔太重。

reviews.text:
I’ve been using the Purito Mighty Bamboo Panthenol Serum and it’s been great for keeping my skin calm, especially since I use mandelic acid at night. The 5% panthenol really helps with redness and irritation, and the texture is lightweight and hydrating without feeling greasy. I like that it has no fragrance or essential oils, so it doesn’t bother my sensitive skin. Overall, it’s a simple, reliable serum that keeps my skin steady and comfortable.

Note: I have sensitive skin, with tendency of redness and rosacea.
reviews.zh:
我一直用 Purito Mighty Bamboo Panthenol Serum，對維持皮膚平靜好有幫助，特別係我晚上會用 mandelic acid。5% 泛醇真係幫到紅位同刺激，質地輕盈又補濕，唔會油膩。我鍾意佢冇香料同精油，所以唔會刺激我嘅敏感皮膚。整體嚟講，係一款簡單、可靠嘅精華，令皮膚保持穩定、舒適。

備註：我嘅皮膚敏感，有泛紅同酒糟（rosacea）傾向。

reviews.text:
This is by far one of the best barrier serums I’ve used. Goes on smooth and does not feel sticky, does not cause breakouts for me either. I have oily combo skin. I’ve used this product for almost two months, mostly at night to help with moisture. My skin in the morning is nice and smooth, has a nice glow to it. However, because the weather has got colder and temperatures are dropping here, I decided to try this during the day. Wears surprisingly smooth under make up alone or with a primer without flacking or peeling. 

Definitely a repurchase for me when I start running low.
reviews.zh:
呢款係我用過最好嘅屏障精華之一。推開順滑，唔黏，同樣唔會令我爆痘。我係油性混合皮膚。我用咗差不多兩個月，主要夜晚用嚟補濕。我嘅皮膚早上摸落好滑，有好靚嘅光澤。不過，因為天氣轉凍、溫度下降，我決定日間都試吓。意外地，佢單獨搽喺化妝底下，或者配合妝前乳，都出奇地服貼，唔會起片或者脫皮。

等用到快冇嗰陣，我一定會再買。

reviews.text: This serum is one of the gentlest I’ve ever used, and from the very first application, I noticed a big difference in how my skin felt, much softer, smoother, and more hydrated than before. I have sensitive skin, and this product really helped to calm irritation and redness. What I love most is that it absorbs super quickly, doesn’t leave any sticky residue, and makes my skin feel fresh, balanced, and comfortable throughout the day. It’s honestly an amazing product.
reviews.zh: 呢款係我用過最溫和嘅精華之一。第一次用就已經感覺到好大分別，皮膚摸落更柔軟、更滑、更水潤。我係敏感皮膚，呢款真係幫手舒緩刺激同泛紅。我最鍾意佢吸收超快，冇黏膩殘留，整日都令皮膚感覺清新、平衡、舒適。真係一款好正嘅產品。

reviews.text: and I started using it with some curiosity because my skin was feeling a bit dry and sensitive due to the weather. From the very first use, I loved the texture — it’s lightweight, fresh, and absorbs super quickly without leaving any sticky feeling. After about a week of consistent use, I noticed my skin looked calmer, softer, and naturally glowy, the kind of glow that shows even without makeup. The dry patches disappeared, and my skin feels much more hydrated and elastic throughout the day. What I love most is that it’s fragrance-free, so it doesn’t irritate my skin, even when it’s feeling sensitive. I’ve also used it after exfoliating or showering, and it always leaves a very soothing and comforting feeling.
reviews.zh: 我帶住少少好奇心開始用呢款，因為天氣令我皮膚有啲乾同敏感。第一次用，我已經好鍾意佢嘅質地——輕盈、清新，吸收超快，冇黏膩感。用咗大約一個星期之後，我發現皮膚睇落更平靜、更柔軟、自然有光澤，係嗰種即使唔化妝都見到嘅光澤。乾燥嘅斑塊消失咗，皮膚全日都感覺更加水潤、有彈性。我最鍾意係佢冇香料，所以即使皮膚敏感都唔會刺激。我去完角質或者沖完涼之後都用過，佢總係帶嚟好舒緩、安慰嘅感覺。

reviews.text: I have used this serum along with the cleanser and thr moisturizer in the same product series for a week now, and it might be too early to make a final judgement, but so far I really like how my skin feels when I use this serum. It's quite thick on the skin but it doesn't feel oily or "heavy". I hope this product series will help my skin barrier, since it was a bit disturbed lately. :(
reviews.zh: 我同同一系列嘅潔面產品同保濕霜一齊用咗一個禮拜。現階段落判斷可能仲未夠早，但係到目前為止，我好鍾意用呢款精華之後皮膚嘅感覺。佢幾厚身，但係唔會覺得油或者「重」。我希望呢個產品系列可以幫到我嘅皮膚屏障，因為佢最近有少少受影響。:(

reviews.text: I’ve been using this serum for a while, and it’s become one of my favourites for soothing and strengthening my skin barrier. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky. It leaves my skin hydrated and calm, especially after cleansing or exfoliating. There’s no strong fragrance, and it layers really well under moisturizer or sunscreen. Overall, it’s a gentle, refreshing serum that gives a nice healthy glow. Definitely worth trying if your skin needs moisture and barrier support. 🌱✨
reviews.zh: 我一直用緊呢款精華一段時間，佢已經成為我最愛嘅舒緩同強化皮膚屏障產品之一。質地輕盈，吸收快，唔會黏。特別係去完角質或者洗完面之後，佢令皮膚保持水潤同平靜。冇強烈香味，喺保濕霜或者防曬底下疊用都好啱。整體嚟講，係一款溫和、清爽嘅精華，令皮膚有健康嘅光澤。如果你皮膚需要補水同屏障支援，絕對值得一試。🌱✨

reviews.text: I'm still waiting for mine to come in the mail, but I borrowed my sister's because my skin barrier got destroyed by a peeling solution. it's very calming and soothing, recommend it 100%. I have oily and extremely sensitive skin, I also have scalp psoriasis and although it's not what the product is meant for, it relieved some of the itchiness for me
reviews.zh: 我嘅貨仲未寄到，所以我借咗我妹妹嘅嚟用，因為我嘅皮膚屏障俾去角質液搞到壞晒。佢好舒緩，絕對推薦。我係油性同極度敏感皮膚，我仲有頭皮銀屑病（psoriasis），雖然呢款產品唔係為咁用而設，但係都令我嘅痕癢舒緩咗啲。
